visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The sequence opens with cinematic footage of a Burning Godzilla figure surrounded by thick white fog and blue lighting. Large red text with white outlines displays '1995', 'バーニングゴジラ', and 'iPASS' in Japanese and English characters across the center frame. (2) Close-up shots highlight the intricate red-and-orange translucent plastic of the Godzilla figure, which glows as if containing internal fire. The texture of the dark skin is bumpy and matte, contrasting with the glossy, glowing patches and the white steam effects. (3) The scene shifts to reveal a square red keychain tag featuring a black Godzilla silhouette and Japanese text. It is held against a black background with warm orange lighting. The camera pans across the tag's surface to show its metallic attachment ring. (4) Extreme close-up shots focus on a small Godzilla head sculpture. The camera tracks across its sharp white teeth, snarling mouth, and a single detailed red eye. The lighting is low-key and dramatic, casting deep shadows over the black scales. (5) The back of the Godzilla head is shown, revealing a circular speaker grille and a label with the 'iPASS PLUS' logo and technical specifications. The background is a vibrant orange-red gradient, and sparks or ember particles float through the air. (6) A pair of human hands enters the frame, demonstrating how the metal carabiner on the Godzilla head keychain can be opened and attached to the strap of a black backpack. The hands are steady and focus on the tactile function of the clip. (7) Multiple rapid cuts show the keychain hanging from the black bag. Each shot uses a different angle or lighting setup, with digital light leaks and flickering embers added for cinematic effect. The Godzilla figure stands prominently in the background. (8) The final shot brings back the initial text overlays while zooming out from the Godzilla head keychain and the full-body figure. The composition is centered and symmetrical, reinforced by the reappearance of the '1995 Burning Godzilla' title cards.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a powerful, low-frequency orchestral rumble followed by a high-pitched, iconic monster roar. The background music features heavy brass and driving percussion at a moderate tempo, creating a dark and epic atmosphere. (2) A series of metallic transition whooshes and bass-heavy impact sounds punctuate the fast visual cuts. The music maintains a constant rhythmic pulse with staccato string patterns and electronic textures layered underneath the primary orchestral themes. (3) A clear, digitized recording of the Godzilla roar is triggered, sounding distinct from the background music. This is followed by the subtle mechanical sound of a metal clip clicking open and closed as a demonstration of the product's hardware. (4) The orchestral theme swells with increased intensity and higher pitch variability. Brass instruments play a descending minor-key melody while the percussion becomes more dense and aggressive, simulating a cinematic trailer style with high arousal and energy. (5) The track concludes with a final resounding drum hit and a long reverberation tail. The music and sound effects fade out together, leaving a brief moment of studio silence at the very end of the recording.
